pattern.description: A stack of nested translucent discs drifts from upper left to centre and settles concentric while an inner sphere fades in and a point of light ignites at its core; wireframe orbit rings tilt around it over a grainy gradient.
pattern.why_premium: Layered translucency, film grain and a single bright focal point make a calm abstract 'voice core' with real depth; the slow settle into perfect concentricity reads as precision and stability, matching 'voice consistency'.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.fromTo(outerDisc, {x:-180, y:-90, scale:1.08}, {x:0, y:0, scale:1, duration:0.6, ease:'power3.out'}); then innerSphere fromTo {opacity:0, scale:0.8} -> {opacity:1, scale:1, duration:0.45, ease:'power2.out'} at '-=0.3'; core glow fromTo {opacity:0, scale:0} -> {opacity:1, scale:1, ease:'expo.out'} at '-=0.2'; rings gsap.to rotation continuously (ease 'none'); background gradient position tween ease 'sine.inOut'.
build_hint.remotion: spring({frame, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:80, mass:1}}) drives disc translate/scale from offset to 0 (no overshoot); inner sphere opacity/scale via a delayed spring (delay ~6 frames); glow opacity interpolate over 6 frames; rings rotate = interpolate(frame, [0, durationInFrames], [0, 20]) linear; background via animated CSS gradient position.

notes: Most moving layers lack candidate boxes, so two manual boxes are used. Camera move is none; the 1.03 scale sum reflects the discs settling, not a camera push. All three SFX candidates look like music bed.
